7. Gather 2 spruce planks (to make the 3 spruce planks needed for the fence gate).
8. Gather 2 stick (to make the 2 sticks needed for the fence gate).
9. Gather 1 spruce fence gate using 2 spruce planks, 1 stick, and 1 spruce log.

This sequence shows how to go from initial resources to the final item, leveraging intermediate crafts to achieve the end goal of creating a spruce fence gate.
